prose: Dylan Saccoccio returns to shed light on the shifting world of currency. In this discussion we get to the root of what money is, why it is used, and how belief systems about currency do not match the original intention of money itself. This overview looks at money through history to inform us about what's going on now in the financial world, with a critical look at crypto, gold, fiat, and other types of exchange.
